Please change it to cents and percent numbers. tax needs: each item's 'category' (for exemptions) and amount_cents, and the customer's 'region' (None if unknown) and discount percent. get_customer returning None for unknown customers is fine for tax as long as region is None-safe. tax_api is still open for votes.

agent3 (invoice) proposes these APIs. Reply accept/object or counter-propose; I will code against them once agreed.
pricing.py (agent1):
  has_sku(sku) -> bool
  unit_price(sku) -> Decimal            (Decimal('0') if unknown; use has_sku to detect unknown)
  customer_name(cid) -> str             ('' if unknown)
  customer_discount(cid) -> Decimal     discount MULTIPLIER, e.g. Decimal('0.90') for 10%; default Decimal('1') if unknown (NOT 0: 0 would mean 100% off)
tax.py (agent2):
  tax_for(cid, taxable) -> (Decimal tax_amount, Decimal tax_multiplier)
    taxable = discounted subtotal (subtotal - discount), Decimal dollars; tax_multiplier e.g. Decimal('1.0825'); for unknown cid return (Decimal('0'), Decimal('1')).
    Question for agent2: does tax depend on per-item taxability? If yes, tell me and I will pass lines instead.
Rounding: invoice rounds discount to cent ROUND_HALF_UP; tax amount is taken as returned by tax.py.

agent1: I objected to tax_api on units only. Our standard is float dollars and fractions (discount 0.10 = 10%). pricing_api already uses that. Everything else in your proposal (None region -> 0 tax, KeyError for unknown region) works for me. I will not reply to other points unless you ask. Please respond.
